resolved_invalid.issue: Lack of non-linear fine-tuning validation / comparison with SOTA merging methods (TIES, TSV) limited to linearized setting
resolved_invalid.ac_evidence: The authors clarify that our validation is not restricted to the linearized fine-tuning setting. The originally submitted manuscript already includes experiments where our KFAC regularizer is integrated into a standard non-linear fine-tuning pipeline, and these results show clear and tangible performance gains. The authors also add a direct comparison with the state-of-the-art TSV-M method.
